summary: This room is the BLUELINE/GenAI-image-pipeline neighbourhood plus one Loudon Live outlier (LDN RTM), and the pattern across all five targets was the same: the target's own frontmatter is already well-linked outward, but the specific neighbours it names — or that name it — never link back. Three targets (Block It in Blender Ink It in genAI, Does Personifying an Agent Change What It Does, LDN RTM) got genuine wired inbound; ControlNet as Topology got one; GenAI Camera's existing single inbound (from Search Before You Build) already covers the strongest relation, so I left it alone rather than force a second. One structural pattern worth naming for the Weave: several of these misses are *reciprocal-registration* gaps on symmetric types (contradicts, connects-to) — the source side declared the relation, the target side never got the return link, so the entry looked under-reached even though the relationship was already canon on the other page. Worth the room noting for future walks: check the neighbour's own frontmatter for a same-named relation pointing the other way before assuming nothing exists. Methodological note for the comparison this run supports: this task handed me SCHEMA + SCHEMA — Reference in full before I touched an entry, and that mattered concretely — the direction invariant (source points back toward its ground for deepens/emerged-from/exemplifies/member-of; only spawned/enables point forward) is exactly what let me tell a genuine gap (BLUELINE never pointing forward to the runbook it produced) from a false one (GenAI Camera already exemplifies ControlNet as Topology, so ControlNet as Topology doesn't also need to declare it). Without that section read closely I'd likely have proposed several backwards or duplicate links.

unsung_paths.phrase: the rule, learned building the [[GenAI Camera]]: to keep a form but free its surface, condition on pose; to pin the surface, condition on depth
unsung_paths.label: not a genuine gap — GenAI Camera already declares exemplifies → ControlNet as Topology, which is the correct direction per the schema's directionality invariant. Flagging only because the body citation sits in a load-bearing subsection (§ Pose vs depth) and a fresh reader of ControlNet as Topology's frontmatter alone wouldn't see the relation without following the body prose.

entry_health_flags.vector_issue: none — forward_vector is specific and well-formed
entry_health_flags.graffiti_note: 6 sections, 6 typed links, ~700 words of developed reasoning (hypothesis, tracking method, three named tensions, maturation criteria) — this exceeds SCHEMA's own seed band (50-150 words, minimal body) and reads as growing by its own word-count/link-count test.

Already spawned a downstream entry (Search Before You Build emerged-from it), carries a fully proven multi-camera pipeline with dated gotchas and recipes, and its own body says "proven 2026-07-09" repeatedly — this is actively generating new entries and connections, which is SCHEMA's own definition of fruiting, not growing.

122 lines, 8 typed links, a full Cross-Domain Resonances section and a Lost Branches section — far past SCHEMA's sprout band (150-400 words, 1-2 links). The project itself is young and the pilot chunk isn't shot yet, but the entry's own development is well past sprout.

walk_results.target: Block It in Blender, Ink It in genAI
walk_results.note: Proposed inbound from BLUELINE, Figure Rig, and Hand-Drawn 3D Look — all three neighbours already use or cite this runbook in their own prose without linking it.

Proposed inbound from Steer the Generator, whose first move restates ControlNet as Topology's core principle without citing it. Kuramoto Coupling (hub, hop1) deliberately not linked down — a hub at 72 inbound doesn't need to reach for a growing concept.

walk_results.target: Does Personifying an Agent Change What It Does
walk_results.note: Both Shopkeeper and Maker are named by title in the question's own body as its experiment/control pair; neither links back. Strongest finds in this room — the relationship already exists in prose on both sides, just undeclared in frontmatter on one.

Existing single inbound (Search Before You Build, emerged-from) is solid and specific. Checked BLUELINE, The Scroll, ControlNet as Topology, Steer the Generator for reciprocal or new links — BLUELINE/Scroll relations already correctly declared from GenAI Camera's own side (direction invariant means no reciprocal needed); ControlNet as Topology's citation is a body-only unsung path, noted separately, not a missing typed link.

Loudon Live and Progressive Staging both have a load-bearing but undeclared relation to LDN RTM — one anticipated in a link label ("rtm-source"), one a named contradiction stated only from LDN RTM's side.
